a: The OSI model has seven layers from physical to application.
TCP uses a three-way handshake to establish a connection.
DNS TTL controls how long a record may be cached.
NAT maps private internal addresses to public ones.
A VPN encrypts traffic over a public network to a private network.
traceroute shows the path packets take to a host.
ping measures reachability and round-trip time with ICMP.
IPv6 provides a much larger address space than IPv4.
Subnets divide networks into smaller address ranges.
TLS secures data in transit; SSL is the obsolete predecessor name.
